messages.subject: Downloading ONLY to specified folder
parts:
Hi all

I wish to download an object ("Table") to a specified location ONLY. 
No worries with user interface (I have not posted details, and I'm taking it as given).
The script below in server.R gives me  the desired output but ALSO attempts to download a blank csv through the browser (I call it a "ghost" download).
If I don't specify a filename ("RandomName.csv" in the script below, the download fails entirely).

Any ideas how to stop the "ghost" browser download?
Do I need an alternative to downloadHandler?


fileName <- reactive({paste("C:/Users/username/Desktop/ShinyOutput/FileName.csv")})

output$TableToDownload <- downloadHandler(
filename = function() {paste("RandomName.csv")},
content = function(file){
write.csv(Table(), file = file.path(fileName()), row.names = FALSE)
})

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Downloading ONLY to specified folder
parts:
In that case you aren't trying to do a "download" at all, but simply writing a csv on the server. Do a write.csv as you are now, but don't use downloadButton or downloadHandler, just use actionButton and observeEvent (see http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/action-buttons.html).

However this only works when the user is running the shiny app in an R process on their own machine. If you deploy to a shiny server or shinyapps.io then there's no way to accomplish what you want.

parts:
Some typos in my script in the message, so correcting for future reference.

in ui.R, swap downloadButton with actionButton:

actionButton("TrialDownload", "Download"):

In server.R the following does the trick:
fileName <- reactive({paste("C:/Users/username/Desktop/ShinyOutput/FileName.csv")})

write.csv(Table(), file = file.path(fileName()), row.names = FALSE)
})

Thanks Joe

You're a wizard! I was hoping you might reply...

On server.R the following does the trick (on ui.R, swap downloadButton with actionButton):
fileName <- reactive({paste("C:/Users/username/Desktop/ShinyOutput/FileName.csv")})

observeEvent(input$TrialDownload,{
write.csv(Table(), file = file.path(fileName1()), row.names = FALSE)
})
